name: Vehicle State Adapter
description: Receives vehicle ignition and power-state events and makes them available to the connectivity software.

name: Bluetooth Connection Manager
description: Controls automatic Bluetooth reconnection attempts, retry behavior, connection timing, and cancellation.

name: Pairing Data Store
description: Stores and retrieves pairing credentials and metadata for previously paired Bluetooth devices.

name: Bluetooth Profile Service
description: Restores supported Bluetooth profiles such as phone audio and media audio after a connection is established.

name: Connectivity Diagnostics Service
description: Records diagnostic events and timing information for Bluetooth connection attempts.
